test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: “Xiao Ye shrinks, not just one but several centimetres” – Why?

options.text: He is angry with the conductor
He feels happy at his achievement
He feels proud of his height

solution:
The correct answer is '**He feels humiliated and hurt**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first sentence of the last paragraph says "***Xiao Ye shrinks, not just one but several centimetres**— the **need for a ticket has all of a sudden become interwoven with the pride of a small child***''. (आखिरी पैराग्राफ का पहला वाक्य कहता है, Xiao Ye सिकुड़ता है, सिर्फ एक नहीं बल्कि कई सेंटीमीटर- टिकट की जरूरत अचानक एक छोटे बच्चे के गौरव के साथ जुड़ गई है)
 
• From the above sentence, we can say that Xiao Ye shrinks, not just one but several centimetres because he feels humiliated and hurt. (उपरोक्त वाक्य से, हम कह सकते हैं कि Xiao Ye सिर्फ एक नहीं बल्कि कई सेंटीमीटर सिकुड़ता है क्योंकि वह अपमानित और आहत महसूस करता है)

 

Hence, the only possible answer is option 1.

63:Tb5c,

The correct answer is '**Tao Ying actually needed to buy two tickets.**'
